description: This file defines the DataRegistrationService class responsible for sending registration data to an external server via HTTP POST, using GuzzleHttp. It includes methods for managing an HTTP client and sending registration information, with error handling and logging.

classes.name: DataRegistrationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling registration data transmission over HTTP, including configuration management and error logging.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HTTP client used for sending requests, configured with a base URI from the configuration.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data as form parameters to a specified registration URL, returns true if successful in production mode, otherwise false, with error logging.
